messages:
miguel (Customer): Hi team — since ~10:15 PT we're seeing intermittent 502s from the hosted /v1/embeddings endpoint. Only when we send batched requests (~200 items). No code changes on our side. Example curl returns 502 about 1/10 requests.

alex (Support): Sorry you're hitting this, miguel. Can you share a sample request payload size and a request id or trace id when it happened? Also which region (us-west1/eu1)?

miguel (Customer): Sending in us-west1. Sample payload is 200 short texts, ~16k tokens total, multipart JSON array. One trace id from last failure: trace=8a1f2d3c. Payload attached in DM.

alex (Support): Thanks — escalating to SRE. @jamie can you take a look at 8a1f2d3c? early hypothesis: h2 keepalive pool exhaustion or upstream conn reset on large batched embedding flows.

jamie (SRE): Looking at edge logs for trace=8a1f2d3c — envoy returned 502 with upstream reset: "upstream_reset_before_response_started". I see a pattern: same client IP had 5 failures in 3m, and upstream (ingress->midproxy) reported conn window stalls.

jamie (SRE): Quick grep output: 
```
[2026-03-18T10:16:02Z] trace=8a1f2d3c envoy_upstream_reset reason=RST_STREAM code=0
[2026-03-18T10:16:02Z] client_ip=3.120.4.5 method=POST path=/v1/embeddings status=502
[2026-03-18T10:16:02Z] upstream=midfront-12 pool_wait_ms=3120 keepalive_pools=exhausted
```

dana (Platform): That pool_wait_ms spike + keepalive_pools=exhausted hints at h2 multiplex pool exhaustion during large bursts. We've seen similar with big batch embeds. Short-term mitigation: reduce concurrency per client or chunk batches. Long-term: increase h2 pool sizes or enable streaming chunking.

alex (Support): Miguel — can you try sending smaller batches (e.g., 50 items) and tell us if 502s stop? Also include retry headers you use.

miguel (Customer): Will try now. One more datapoint: these requests are non-streaming, client waits for full response. We do linear backoff (1s,2s,4s) on 502 and give up after 3 tries.

miguel (Customer): Quick test with 50-item batches: 10/10 success so far (no 502). Looks like batch size correlates.

jamie (SRE): Good repro. For full triage we'll capture tcpdump + Envoy trace for a failing large batch. If you can reproduce, please set header `X-Debug-Trace: 1` to keep traces.

alex (Support): Providing steps for reproducible failure for SRE: 
1) POST /v1/embeddings to us-west1 with 200 items in array
2) include `Authorization: Bearer <token>` and `X-Debug-Trace: 1`
3) set concurrency=4 (parallel clients)
4) capture response status + trace header

jamie (SRE): We've also seen transient 504s when midproxy stalls waiting for upstream ack on large bodies. Tentative root cause: conn pool sizing + h2 flow control window drift leading to envoy issuing reset. We'll validate whether a recent kernel update changed keepalive behavior on midproxy hosts (rolling deploy last week).

dana (Platform): Action items:
- jamie: collect full envoy/access logs + metrics (h2_conn_open, h2_conn_close, conn_pool_wait) for 10:14-10:20 PT, correlate with rolling deploys.
- infra-bot: pin midproxy ASG to previous image for one shard to test rollback (short window).
- alex: advise miguel to chunk batches as workaround and add jittered retries.

infra-bot: ASG rollback started for midproxy-group-a -> target image v2026.03.09 (rolling, 12 hosts). ETA ~8m.

jamie (SRE): Collected full traces and a pcap from a repro run (attached to incident). Quick summary: when batch >150 items, the upstream send stalls ~1800ms waiting for window update, envoy drops stream with RST_STREAM. Not authentication related.

jamie (SRE): Relevant envoy log snippet: 
```
[envoy] stream decode error: upstream reset RST_STREAM (0) on stream id=7 after write. send window=0 recv window=65536
```

alex (Support): FYI customer confirmed chunking fixed it. miguel, sorry for disruption — we'll follow up with root cause and ETA for a permanent fix (config + canary rollback validated). Appreciate your patience. :pray:

miguel (Customer): Thanks all — chunking and increased retry helped for now. Please keep me posted, we may want longer-term SLA notes if this repeats.

dana (Platform): We'll open a tracking ticket for h2 pool autosizing + keepalive tuning. Also evaluating adding 502-specific retry guidance to docs for large batch embeds.

jamie (SRE): Postmortem plan: collect metrics, validate rollback effect, prod a config diff to increase connection pool high-water mark, add guard rails for very large single-request batches. Will update thread when rollback completes and we have numbers.

alex (Support): Closing loop for now; migration ticket: PLAT-4321 (h2-pool-autosize). I'll link the incident artifacts there.

infra-bot: ASG rollback completed for midproxy-group-a. No immediate degradations observed on canary hosts.

jamie (SRE): After rollback canary: conn_pool_wait 99p dropped from 2.1s -> 120ms, downstream 502 rate for large-batch clients reduced ~95%. Looks promising. Follow-up scheduled for config rollout next week.

miguel (Customer): That's great news — thanks everyone.

alex (Support): Marking thread resolved for support side. Please ping if you see recurrence. :thumbsup:
